edits.label: Read-only Windows metadata beside original per-channel confirmed state

val tripleCelebrationFinished: Boolean = false,
    val desktopLikeFeedbackOrigin: com.bilipai.desktop.ui.DesktopWindowsVideoFeedbackOrigin? = null,
    val desktopMaidFeedbackOrigin: com.bilipai.desktop.ui.DesktopWindowsVideoFeedbackOrigin? = null,
    val desktopTripleFeedbackOrigin: com.bilipai.desktop.ui.DesktopWindowsVideoFeedbackOrigin? = null
)

edits.label: Confirmed Like source captured in the same owned CAS; unlike clears its receipt
edits.before:
maidAction = null,
                            likeBurstId = if (liked) current.likeBurstId + 1 else current.likeBurstId
edits.after:
maidAction = null,
                            likeBurstId = if (liked) current.likeBurstId + 1 else current.likeBurstId,
                            desktopMaidFeedbackOrigin = null,
                            desktopLikeFeedbackOrigin = if (liked) com.bilipai.desktop.ui.DesktopWindowsVideoFeedbackOrigin.capture(com.bilipai.desktop.ui.DesktopWindowsVideoFeedbackKind.LIKE, current.likeBurstId + 1, current.subject) else null

edits.label: Confirmed Dislike source metadata; no optimistic receipt

maidActionId = if (disliked) current.maidActionId + 1 else current.maidActionId,
                            desktopLikeFeedbackOrigin = null,
                            desktopMaidFeedbackOrigin = if (disliked) com.bilipai.desktop.ui.DesktopWindowsVideoFeedbackOrigin.capture(com.bilipai.desktop.ui.DesktopWindowsVideoFeedbackKind.DISLIKE, current.maidActionId + 1, current.subject) else null,

edits.label: Confirmed Coin source metadata in original protocol-success commit
edits.after:

                            desktopLikeFeedbackOrigin = null,

edits.label: Only actual allSuccess triple obtains the captured accepted source receipt
edits.after:
tripleCelebrationFinished = false,
                                desktopLikeFeedbackOrigin = null,
                                desktopMaidFeedbackOrigin = null,
                                desktopTripleFeedbackOrigin = if (result.allSuccess) com.bilipai.desktop.ui.DesktopWindowsVideoFeedbackOrigin.capture(com.bilipai.desktop.ui.DesktopWindowsVideoFeedbackKind.TRIPLE, celebrationId, current.subject) else null

edits.label: Original expected-id Like dismissal retires only that channel receipt
edits.before: if (expectedId == null || it.likeBurstId == expectedId) it.copy(likeBurstVisible = false) else it
edits.after: if (expectedId == null || it.likeBurstId == expectedId) it.copy(likeBurstVisible = false, desktopLikeFeedbackOrigin = null) else it

edits.label: Only a stamped share presentation can produce renderable share metadata; no global listener
edits.after:
maidActionId = it.maidActionId + 1,
                desktopLikeFeedbackOrigin = null,
                desktopMaidFeedbackOrigin = com.bilipai.desktop.ui.DesktopWindowsVideoFeedbackOrigin.capture(com.bilipai.desktop.ui.DesktopWindowsVideoFeedbackKind.SHARE, it.maidActionId + 1, it.subject)

edits.label: Original expected-id Maid dismissal retires matching metadata
edits.before: if (it.maidActionId == expectedId) it.copy(maidAction = null) else it
edits.after: if (it.maidActionId == expectedId) it.copy(maidAction = null, desktopMaidFeedbackOrigin = null) else it

edits.label: Original completed-current Triple retires only matching origin
edits.after: it.copy(tripleCelebrationVisible = false, tripleCelebrationFinished = true, desktopTripleFeedbackOrigin = null)

edits.label: Original cancellation does not mark completion
edits.after: it.copy(tripleCelebrationVisible = false, tripleCelebrationFinished = false, desktopTripleFeedbackOrigin = null)
